quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA IR presentation: GTC Berlin 2026 Keynote (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GTC Berlin 2026 keynote deck: the NVIDIA DSX full-stack AI factory platform slide lists Vera Rubin NVL72, NVLink 6 Switch, Vera BlueField-4 Compute, Spectrum-6 Switch, Groq 3 LPX, Vera BlueField-4 Storage (STX) and Vera RTX Compute systems; the slide 'NVIDIA Vera Rubin Powers the Whole Agent' assigns the Vera Rubin NVL72 compute node to model processing, the Vera MGX compute node to secure agent processing, the Vera CMX storage node to knowledge serving and the Vera RTX compute node to CUDA-X tools processing.

quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA IR presentation: GTC Berlin 2026 Keynote (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GTC Berlin 2026 keynote deck, NVIDIA Nemotron customization ('Turn Proprietary Data Into Sovereign Intelligence', NVIDIA's own slides): customized Nemotron models are shown gaining accuracy over frontier models - Nemotron 3.5 Super VL +41 versus GPT 6.1 Sol, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning +40 versus GPT 5.4 Nano, Nemotron 3 Ultra +30 versus GPT 5.5, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL +15 versus Claude Opus 5 and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning +20 versus Claude Opus 5.5. The NVIDIA Agent Knowledge Foundation slides rank nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Parse first on ParseBench, nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Embed-8B-BF16 first on LMEB, nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B-BF16 first on ViDoRe v3 and Kumo-Tabular first on BeyondArena (1426).
quarterly_data.figure: Nemotron accuracy gains of +41, +40, +30, +15 and +20 points on NVIDIA's slides
